static_traits.name: Ma Xiao
static_traits.family_status: Has two children with his wife, often goes camping together on weekends
static_traits.social_status: Has support from wife and close friends, but struggles to open up about inferiority; sensitive to others' evaluations in Social situations, feeling uneasy
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychological problems or treatment experience
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe specific situations and thoughts; negative tone, skeptical about counseling; fairly cooperative (willing to try exercises but unsure of their effect)

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling others hold negative views of me because of my truck-driver profession, producing inferiority and Self-doubt, feeling judged almost daily in Social situations or when meeting new friends.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this inferiority has begun affecting my Interpersonal relationships and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: About a year ago overheard someone comment that truck drivers are 'always away from home too long'; the comment initially triggered moderate stress, then gradually developed into persistently worrying about being looked down on in Social situations; despite family and friends consistently giving affirmation and praise, the client still struggles to digest positive feedback, with persistent self-doubt, affecting sleep and mood.

special_situations.event: About a year ago hearing someone say truck drivers are 'never home', the negative professional comment triggered the client's inferiority and Self-doubt
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my profession makes people see it as undignified or unimportant, then I as a person have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to rationalize and seeking comfort and recognition from family to relieve Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone thinks I am terrible; my work is not respected

special_situations.event: When meeting new friends or attending Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If strangers do not approve of my profession, it means I am inferior
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaks cautiously in social settings, reduces talking about work details, psychologically defends in advance to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will surely look down on me

special_situations.event: Repeatedly falling into Self-doubt even after receiving praise and support from family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only widespread external recognition can prove my worth; praise from close ones does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly seeking reassurance from family and friends, but quickly dismissing such positive information
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just comforting me; I am still not good enough

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues or social contacts and work topics are mentioned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' evaluations of truck drivers are all aimed at me personally
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on possible negative cues, tense and avoidant to reduce the risk of being criticized
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: What they think of truck drivers is what they think of me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be respected and recognized and to feel one's own worth seen
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being belittled and rejected, worrying one is unimportant and undignified
defense_goal: Seeking external reassurance to maintain self-esteem
In socializing, stays defensive and avoidant to avoid being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is easily looked down on and needs external validation
object_relations.object_representation: Internal representation of strangers / social others as prejudiced judges who will look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to challenge negative thinking, examine evidence, or do behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding the counselor's exploration as potentially exposing one's 'not good enough', worrying about being judged, believing counseling may be ineffective
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious, reserved tone, frequently using expressions like 'I am not sure' and 'may not be useful', prioritizing logic and evidence to avoid the emotional level.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When work is discussed in social settings or others focus on one's career
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' neutral attention as contempt or negation (attributing one's own shame and unease to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using speculative statements like 'they look down on me' and 'they must think I am unimportant', keeping distance and reducing self-disclosure.

manifestations: Equates the profession's 'decency / respectability' with personal worth
Believes others look down on one's work, thus doubting one's own significance
Persistently worrying about being judged in social settings

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations: 'he looks down on me', 'they want to exclude me', etc.
manifestations: Imagining strangers will look down on oneself in Social situations
Attributing work insecurity to others' evaluations
Making negative assumptions about others' thoughts (e.g., 'they will surely look down on me')

positive_force: Family and friends give positive affirmation (praising her diligence and the value of her work)
Work performance not yet affected (work ability stable)
Willing to try challenging thoughts and practicing
Has stable joint activities with family (weekend camping); emotional support exists
Able to describe one's thoughts and trigger situations clearly
negative_force: Cognitive biases are marked, such as mind reading, overgeneralization, and personalization
Overly dependent on external approval, tends to ignore positive feedback
Persistent tension and Self-doubt in Social situations
Difficulty opening up to family and friends about insufficiency and shame

target_behavior.behavior: Anxiety about being judged and Self-doubt in interpersonal and Social situations
antecedent: Meeting new friends or attending Social gatherings
Recalling or hearing negative comments about truck drivers
target_behavior.core_reason: Generalizing one negative comment into 'most people look down on me', equating professional respect with personal worth, forming dependence on external recognition
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of humiliation, protects self-esteem, and seeks comfort and recognition
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal interactions affected, decreased self-confidence, impaired sleep and mood (overall happiness lowered)
